_comment: Security gate policy. security_gate.py reads every scan report and blocks the release if any rule below is broken. A missing or unreadable report also blocks (fail closed).

pip_audit._comment: pip-audit has no severity field, so any known vulnerability that already has a fixed version blocks.

trivy_image._comment_unfixed: Debian has published no fix for some base-image CVEs. Those cannot be remediated by rebuilding, so they are reported but do not block. Everything with a fixed version blocks.
